text:
maria: Quick sync on CloudLoom partnership launch: marketplace listing, integration blog, and a joint webinar. Need owners and deadlines. :calendar:
jasper: I can own partner comms + marketplace checklist. They want co-branded hero + 60s demo clip. Can deliver logos by Mon.
sara: Ill write the integration blog and moderate webinar. Need 3 screenshots and a small curl snippet from eng.
oliver: Ill record the 60s demo if I get a script and sandbox creds by Thu. Requesting test tenant + API key.
rachel: Benchmarks: I'll produce one slide (latency vs baseline) and a one-sentence takeaway. Need to run tests by Wed.
leo: Inbound routing plan: tag all leads with campaign=CLDLM_LAUNCH_2026_04_08 and set lead_source=partner_cloudloom for partner pushes. I'll create SFDC campaign + LP with utms.
maria: Proposed deadlines: logos by Mon, demo script Wed AM, blog draft Thu, webinar slides next Mon. Checkpoint next Tue 10am PT. Agree?
jasper: Agree. I'll send partner comms now and request their demo footage. If they don't send, we'll screen-capture.
sara: Draft outline for blog: 1) why partnership, 2) integration walkthrough + curl example, 3) performance highlight, 4) CTA to listing + webinar.
leo: Webhook example for partner lead pushes (ops): POST /webhooks/mktg payload {"lead_email":"...","campaign":"CLDLM_LAUNCH_2026_04_08","partner":"cloudloom"}
maria: Action owners: jasper=assets & partner comms, sara=blog + moderation, oliver=demo recording, rachel=benchmarks, leo=inbound routing & LP. Thanks all—post blockers here. :white_check_mark:
